data.name: Esteban
data.gender_notes: Esteban is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Hebrew ‘Hananiah’ meaning ‘God has favored.’ In the New Testament, Esteban (also known as Stephen) was a deacon and one of the first Christian martyrs. He was a Hellenist, a Jew born in Cyprus who spoke Greek, and his speech at the Jerusalem Council is recorded in the Acts of the Apostles. His martyrdom was a turning point in the early Christian community as it showed the persecution they faced and the importance of standing firm in faith.
data.etymology: Esteban belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God has favored.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esteban total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אסטבן
in_hebrew.meaning: הוא כוכב, נזר, או אבן יקרה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אסטבן מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו כוכב, נזר, או אבן יקרה. הוא נגזר מהמילה היוונית סטפאנוס (Στεφανός), שפירושה כתר או זריון. השם אסטבן הוא גרסה ספרדית של השם סטפן, שמקורו בברית החדשה ומתייחס לסטפנוס, אחד מהאבות הראשונים של הכנסייה הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Εστέβαν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εστέβαν είναι η ισπανική εκδοχή του ονόματος Στεφανός, που σημαίνει κορόνη, στεφάνι ή στέφανος. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Στεφανός ήταν ένας από τους πρώτους διακόνους της Εκκλησίας και αναφέρεται στις Πράξεις των Αποστόλων. Το όνομα έχει ισχυρή σημασία στην παράδοση Χριστιανική, συμβολίζοντας τη νίκη και την αθανασία.

in_latin.name: Esteban
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Esteban derivatur ex Graeco Στεφανός (Stephanus), quod corona vel insignis interpretatur. In traditione Christiana, nomen Esteban refertur ad Stephanum, unum ex primis diaconis Ecclesiae, qui martyrizatus est propter fidem in Actibus Apostolorum descriptam. Nomen significat victoriam et aeternitatem in spirituali contextu.

in_english.name: Esteban
in_english.long_meaning: The name Esteban is of Greek origin, derived from Stephanus (Στεφανός), meaning crown, wreath, or garland. It is a significant name in Christian tradition, referring to Saint Stephen, one of the first deacons of the Church, who was martyred for his faith as described in the Acts of the Apostles. The name Esteban symbolizes victory, honor, and spiritual achievement, reflecting its biblical and historical roots.

data.cultural_impact: The name Esteban is rich in history and is present in multiple cultures, especially in the Hispanic world. In Spain, for example, St. Stephen of Hungary was a popular figure and his feast day is celebrated on August 2. In Portugal, St. Stephen is the patron saint of Lisbon, and his tomb in the city's cathedral is considered a pilgrimage site. The name Esteban is also present in popular culture, with figures such as Esteban "Steve" Reeves, an American bodybuilder and actor, and Esteban "Steve" Buscemi, an American actor.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Esteban carries a deep spiritual significance as it is the name of one of the earliest Christian martyrs. St. Stephen was a deacon in the early Christian community in Jerusalem, and his steadfast faith and courage in the face of persecution continue to inspire Christians today. He is remembered for his powerful speaking skills, which helped him defend his faith against those who opposed it. Stephen's martyrdom marks an important turning point in the history of Christianity as it shows the challenges and sacrifices required for followers of Christ. The legacy of St. Stephen reminds us of the importance of steadfastness in our own faith journey and inspires us to be bold in sharing the good news of Christ with others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Esteban, meaning "crown" or "garland" in Hebrew, symbolizes the divine adornment bestowed upon believers in their spiritual journey towards union with God. In the New Testament, St. Stephen, whose name is Esteban in Spanish, wore the crown of martyrdom, exemplifying the highest form of devotion and faith.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Saint Esteban was a Christian martyr in the 4th century. The name Esteban carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
